battle.name: 沔州之戰
battle.brief: 端平三年（1235），蒙古軍三路南下攻宋，沔州即今湖北仙桃沔城，扼漢水下游，是襄陽、江陵之間的軍需渡口。宋守軍閉城固守，蒙古列配重投石車（回回砲）於城下，連日拋石破堞，再用撞車與雲梯貼城。城破後蒙古據沔州扼漢水，襄鄂西翼洞開，數年後襄陽、鄂州相繼失守。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰雙方是蒙古帝國與南宋。1235年，窩闊台在北方與西域的戰事暫告一段落，於是分兵三路南下攻宋：術魯剌與貴由兩路出河東、關中，進取唐、鄧一線；拖雷一路領精兵自漢中南下，取道蜀口，圖取成都，並準備迂迴襄、鄂；各路之外另有偏師出陝、豫，遙相策應。沔州之戰是這一輪南征中南線的一環，由拖雷所率的漢地攻勢推進到荊襄，蒙古本軍與歸附的漢軍共同擔任攻城任務，並調來回回炮手與隨軍工匠。西域回回籍與漢籍炮手、匠人編在回回炮軍之中，隨大軍轉戰，是攻城砲隊的骨幹。南宋方面，沔州為沔州軍所治，隸荊湖北路，上游通襄陽，下游抵江陵、武昌，處在宋廷京湖防線的腹地。守軍由知州與部將統轄，聽京湖制置司調度；襄陽、江陵、武昌三處屯重兵，沔州則是前線州郡、軍糧轉運站與漢水船隊的集結地。雙方都清楚：沔州一下，漢水航路即為敵手，襄鄂兩鎮的門戶洞開。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Southern Song. In 1235, with the northern and western campaigns temporarily settled, Ögedei split his forces into three columns marching south against Song: the columns of Jalal al-Din and Küchüg operating out of Hedong and the Guanzhong region toward Tang and Deng, and the column of Töregene, who led picked troops down from Hanzhong, took the road through the Sichuan passes, aimed at Chengdu, and prepared to turn south and around toward Xiangyang and Ezhou. Detachments also came out of Shaanxi and Henan to support the advance. The Battle of Mianzhou belongs to the southern arm of this campaign, where the offensive driven by Töregene's host reached Jingxiang; Mongol troops and surrendered Han troops alike carried the assault, with Uyghur-Muslim and Han gunners and craftsmen brought along to operate the artillery. These artisans, organised into the Huihui pao corps, travelled with the army and formed the backbone of the siege artillery. On the Song side, Mianzhou was governed as Mianzhou Army within Jinghu Circuit, linked upstream to Xiangyang and downstream to Jiangling and Wuchang, sitting in the middle of the capital's Jinghu defensive line. Its garrison was commanded by the prefect and his officers under the Jinghu Regional Defence Commission; Xiangyang, Jiangling and Wuchang each held substantial armies, while Mianzhou was a forward prefecture, a military supply depot and the assembly point of the Han River boat fleet. Both sides understood the stakes: once Mianzhou fell, the Han River route belonged to the enemy and the gates of Xiang and E were thrown wide.
people: 蒙古方面，拖雷為窩闊台之子，此次南征的主將之一，負責漢中、蜀口與荊襄方向的戰略迂迴；術魯剌為察合台之子，領兵自河東向河南推進，與拖雷呈南北呼應；貴由亦率一軍入蜀。三人皆為宗王，軍事上互不統屬，遇事臨機決斷是常態。攻城現場真正決定技術細節的是蒙古軍中的回回炮手與隨軍匠人：他們架設配重投石車、定拋射距離、備石彈與火藥炸彈；另有工匠造撞車、雲梯、攻城塔與望車，騎兵則負責封鎖漢水、遮斷援軍。宋方領軍人物中，孟珙在端平三年前後總領荊襄軍務，駐武昌、江陵一線，以整軍、汰弱留強、專設守城砲兵與修築城壘著稱，他對蒙古攻城器械的認識，直接來自這幾年與西線守軍的對峙；秦友守襄陽，以敢戰、能持重著稱；高達後來領江陵，在1239年江陵之戰中擊退兀良哈台一軍；呂文德則長期主持荊襄軍務，是南宋末期襄樊線上的關鍵人物之一。沔州本地的守城指揮者姓名，現存史籍記載已經零散不完整，只知其為京湖制置司直轄的知州與部將，於城破之後退走。
peopleEn: On the Mongol side, Töregene, a son of Ögedei, was one of the commanders of the southern campaign, responsible for the Hanzhong-Sichuan approaches and for the strategic turn toward Jingxiang; Jalal al-Din, son of Chagatai, drove south from Hedong into Henan in support; Küchüg led a further army into Sichuan. All three were princes of the blood and did not subordinate themselves to one another, so decisions on the ground were taken case by case. The figures who actually determined the technical details at the siege wall were the Huihui gunners and the engineers who marched with the army: they set up the counterweight trebuchets, fixed the ranges, and prepared stone shot and powder-filled shells; other craftsmen built battering rams, siege ladders, siege towers and observation carts, while cavalry screened the Han River and cut off relief columns. On the Song side, Meng Gong took charge of the Jingxiang command around this time, holding Wuchang and Jiangling, and was famous for reorganising the army, keeping only the fit, creating specialist artillery and garrison troops, and strengthening the walls. His knowledge of the Mongol siege equipment came directly from several years of contact with the western line. Qin You held Xiangyang and was noted for both courage and steadiness; Gao Da later took command at Jiangling and beat back the army of Ulughadai in 1239; Lü WenDe ran the Jingxiang command for years and became one of the key men of the Xiangfan front in the Song's last decades. The names of the Mianzhou garrison commanders themselves survive only in scattered, incomplete form: what is known is that the city was held by a prefect and officers answerable to the Jinghu Commission, and that they withdrew after the breach.
kits: 本卡的配重投石車是此役的攻城骨幹。蒙古軍所使用者稱回回砲：長臂、短樞、巨櫃形配重箱，靠自重翻轉把石彈拋出，射程數十至百五十步上下，彈重數百斤，重的可達逾千斤；另有一種在石彈或陶罐中裝火藥、插入引信，觸地即炸的攻城炸彈，一併隨砲使用。配重投石車的技術在十一世紀已於西西里與西亞普及，蒙古西征把它帶到東方，回回匠人隨軍攜來，1231年攻潼關已用此砲，1235年南征各路都帶上。沔州城下，砲列於城壕外或城中望樓之側，連日轟擊，目標是女牆、馬面與城門構件，一邊壓制頭頂守軍，一邊把進攻點打塌。宋軍守城除弓弩、火器之外，配重砲、砲石車、霹靂砲（陶罐裝火藥、外插引線、擲出即炸）、石砲、拒馬、鹿角、壕溝、陷馬坑、擲石、毒煙火瓶同樣成套；水軍以舟師控制漢水江面，阻止蒙古把攻城器械由水路運入城下。兩軍都靠漢水與襄漢間的車船運糧，把攻城與防禦的成敗壓在補給線上。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on this card was the backbone of the siege. The Mongol version was called the Huihui pao: a long throwing arm on a short pivot, driven by a large box-shaped counterweight that reversed under its own mass to hurl the shot. Its range ran from several dozen to about a hundred and fifty paces, the shot weighing several hundred jin and in the heaviest cases well over a thousand; alongside it travelled a powder shell fitted with a fuse, either strapped to stone or packed in a ceramic jar, that detonated on impact. The trebuchet had been in widespread use in Sicily and West Asia since the eleventh century, and the Mongol conquests carried the design eastward with Uyghur-Muslim craftsmen travelling in the train of the armies; the type was already used against Tongguan in 1231, and every column of the 1235 southern campaign brought its own. Below the walls of Mianzhou the engines stood outside the ditch or beside the towers inside the city and kept firing day after day, aimed at the parapets, the wall-walk towers and the structural members of the gates, suppressing the defenders overhead while wrecking the chosen assault point. The Song defence, besides bows and crossbows and fire weapons, fielded counterweight engines and stone-throwing catapults as well, along with thunder-crash bombs (ceramic jars packed with powder, a fuse fitted outside, bursting where they landed), stone cannons, cheval-de-frise, abatis, ditches, horse pits, hand-thrown stones and smoke pots; the river flotilla patrolled the Han River to stop the Mongols bringing siege gear up by water. Both sides lived off the same artery, the Han River and the boat-and-cart road between Xiangyang and Hanzhong, which is why the outcome of the siege and the defence rested on the supply line.
tactics: 蒙古軍的攻城作戰有固定次序：先以大隊騎兵與弓弩手在城外展開，清掃障礙、逼退宋軍出城反擊，再把砲隊前推到射程之內，晝夜轟擊城垣；待堞牆與城樓受損、守軍頭頂火力被壓住，才以撞車、雲梯、攻城塔分批貼城，突擊手攀城；同時分兵封鎖漢水航道、斷宋軍糧道，並在援軍來路上設伏圍打，務求不使襄、鄂、沔三處互相接應。攻城器械一旦受損，即派騎兵掩護重造，退回原地的代價太高。宋軍的守法與之相對：以深溝高壘與分段的城垣把有限的城防拉成幾道死線，用弩砲遠射干擾蒙古砲的拋射，迫其前移而暴露在頭頂；以霹靂砲與火藥在城頭反制攀城者；出城夜襲焚燒回回砲與撞車；水軍在漢水巡弋，斷敵舟師；內外兩重城垣逐段退守，保住糧倉與水源。孟珙整軍的結果，是把這支以步卒與城防為主的軍隊練成有專職砲兵、有預定反擊程序的守軍，沔州一役的教訓，成為後來江陵、襄樊防禦的藍本。
tacticsEn: The Mongol siege followed a fixed sequence. Cavalry and crossbowmen first deployed outside the walls, clearing obstacles and driving back Song counterattacks; the artillery was then pushed forward into range and worked on the walls day and night; only once the parapets and gate towers had been damaged and the defenders' fire from above had been beaten down did battering rams, ladders and siege towers go up to the walls in successive batches, with shock troops climbing. At the same time detachments sealed the Han River channel, cut the Song grain road, and ambushed relief columns on the roads, doing everything to keep Xiang, E and Mianzhou from supporting one another. If the siege equipment was damaged, cavalry screened the work of rebuilding it, because the cost of withdrawing was prohibitive. The Song defence was the mirror image of this. Deep ditches, high revetments and a wall divided into separate sections stretched a limited defence into several lines of death; crossbows and light artillery fired at the Mongol engines to spoil their shooting and force them forward into exposure; thunder-crash bombs and powder were used from the parapets against the climbers; sorties at night burned the Huihui engines and the rams; the flotilla patrolled the Han River to cut the enemy's boats; and two lines of wall were given up section by section to preserve the granaries and the water. Meng Gong's reorganisation turned an army of foot soldiers and wall-holders into a garrison with specialist gunners and a set procedure for counterattack, and the lessons of Mianzhou became the template for the defences of Jiangling and Xiangfan that followed.
data: 可以引用的數字大致有這些。拖雷南征之軍，《元史》記作精兵三萬五千人；三路大軍合計，兵員以數十萬計。沔州城周圍數里，城牆高數丈，中有城樓、馬面、女牆，外築壕溝。蒙古用在城下的砲，通常記為數十門；配重投石車的實際射程約數十至一百五十步，石彈重數百斤至逾千斤，攻城炸彈的破壞力則以火藥量決定。宋軍霹靂砲的有效射程約一二百步，弩砲中以神臂弓最遠，射程可及三百步上下。水路上，沔州順漢水至襄陽約二百餘里，至江陵約三百里；蒙古由漢中入蜀再折向荊襄，行程以數千里計。攻城歷時沒有可靠數字，只能說在數十日至一月有餘之間，因此守軍遷徙、器械損耗與糧秣消耗的細帳都已散佚。凡涉及精確兵員、砲數、彈重與攻防日期的記載，多為後世紀事者的概說，須與其他文獻互證後方可使用。
dataEn: The figures that can safely be quoted are roughly these. The army Töregene took south is recorded in the History of Yuan as thirty-five thousand picked troops; taken together the three columns numbered in the tens of thousands. The walls of Mianzhou ran for several li, rose several zhang high, and carried towers, wall-walk bastions and parapets, with a ditch dug outside. The number of engines brought against the city is usually given as several dozen; the practical range of a counterweight trebuchet was from some tens of paces to about a hundred and fifty, stone shot weighing several hundred jin and occasionally more than a thousand, while the destructive power of the powder shells was set by the charge of powder. The effective range of the Song thunder-crash bombs was about one to two hundred paces, and among the crossbows the strongest, the divine arm bow, could shoot to roughly three hundred paces. By water, Mianzhou lies about two hundred and some li up the Han River from Xiangyang and about three hundred from Jiangling; the Mongol march from Hanzhong through Sichuan and then round into Jingxiang was measured in thousands of li. There is no reliable figure for the length of the siege, only that it ran from several tens of days to rather more than a month, which is why the details of the garrison's movement, the loss of equipment and the consumption of grain and fodder are lost. Every statement about exact troop numbers, gun counts, shot weights and the days of attack and defence is the general summary of later chroniclers and needs corroboration against other documents before use.
cause: 1235年的攻宋，是蒙古在歐亞大陸上完成主要征服之後，把戰線轉向南方、要求南宋臣服的必然一步。窩闊台清楚知道：南宋據有江南膏腴之地與龐大人口，只要南宋不降，蒙古就無法取得穩定的賦稅與兵源，統一便不完整。於是在北方防線暫時無事時傾力南征，同時尋求在江淮建立跳板，把戰爭推到有產糧、有水運、有造船能力的江南腹地。直接導致沔州開打的，是端平北伐的失敗：1234年宋廷收復三京的軍事冒險耗盡了國力，卻沒有守住已得的北方，兩淮、京西防線反而洞開，蒙古得以集中全部兵力南下。沔州在戰略上的份量因此格外重：它扼漢水，是漢中、襄陽、江陵、武昌之間唯一可通舟楫、可行軍的南北縱貫線的一段，控制沔州等於拿到打開荊襄的大門；拿下這座城，蒙古可以直接徵用漢水的船、糧、馬，把後續攻勢直接送進長江中游。
causeEn: The attack on Song in 1235 was the inevitable next step once the Mongols had completed their main conquests across Eurasia: the front moved south and Song was to be made to submit. Ögedei understood plainly that the Song held the richest lands of the south and a vast population; so long as it did not surrender, the Mongols could not draw stable taxes and soldiers, and the unification would remain incomplete. So while the northern front was quiet, everything was thrown into the southward offensive, and a foothold in the Jiang-Huai region was sought so that the war could be carried into the productive, navigable and shipbuilding heartland of the Yangtze delta. What triggered the fighting at Mianzhou directly was the failure of the Duanping northern expedition: the military gamble of 1234 to recover the three northern capitals exhausted the state without holding what had been taken, the defences of Lianghu and Jingxi fell open, and the Mongols were able to concentrate their whole strength to the south. Mianzhou's strategic weight was therefore exceptional. It held the Han River, the one stretch of the north-south artery along which boats could pass and armies could march between Hanzhong, Xiangyang, Jiangling and Wuchang. To control Mianzhou was to hold the key to Jingxiang; to take the city was to lay hands directly on the Han River's boats, grain and horses, and to carry the next stage of the campaign straight down to the middle Yangtze.
impact: 沔州落下的直接後果，是襄鄂防線的西側被打通。1236年前後蒙古軍相繼攻取襄陽、鄂州、江陵，南宋在江淮以北的屏障大部崩解，蒙古兵鋒第一次成建制地抵近長江中游，長江天險從此不再獨屬南宋。沔州自此成為蒙古在荊襄的補給節點，糧秣與攻城器械由漢水直下，前線的維持成本被壓到很低，而南宋要再堵缺口，只能在江陵、鄂州一線重築。更深一層的影響在技術上：配重投石車隨蒙古軍深入中國，砲體之巨、射程之遠、拋射之密，令宋廷不得不把攻城砲術與火藥武器放進同一張兵力表裡。守城的重砲、霹靂砲與專職砲兵相繼制度化，砲兵與守城工程第一次在宋軍編制裡取得可以辨認的位置，歐亞大陸一千多年累積的攻城技術，就此在宋與蒙古之間被並排比較、互相吸收，這條技術線一直通到1260年代的襄樊攻防。
impactEn: The direct consequence of Mianzhou's fall was that the western flank of the Xiang-E line was opened. In and around 1236 the Mongols took Xiangyang, Ezhou and Jiangling in turn; most of Song's screen north of the Yangtze collapsed, and Mongol banners reached the middle Yangtze for the first time as organised armies, meaning that the great river barrier no longer belonged to the Song alone. Mianzhou from then on served as a supply node for the Mongol operations in Jingxiang, with grain and siege gear running straight down the Han River and the cost of holding the front driven very low; for the Song, the only way to close the gap again was to rebuild defences on the Jiangling and Ezhou line. The deeper effect was technical. The counterweight trebuchet went deep into China in Mongol hands, and the size of the engines, the reach of their shooting and the density of their fire forced the Song court to put siege artillery and powder weapons on the same establishment list. Heavy defending guns, thunder-crash bombs and specialist artillery crews were institutionalised in turn, and artillery and fortification engineering acquired for the first time a recognisable place in the Song order of battle. The accumulated siegecraft of more than a thousand years across Eurasia was now set side by side, compared and absorbed between Song and Mongol, and that line of technical development runs straight through to the sieges of Xiangfan in the 1260s.
result: 結果是蒙古軍攻下了沔州。守軍的姓名、編制與退走路線在現存文獻中已經模糊，只知城破之後守軍退保江陵、武昌一線，沔州為蒙古軍所據，元初在此設官置治、改隸湖廣行省管轄，把沔州從邊州變成供應襄鄂前線的後方節點。對南宋而言，沔州之敗是端平以來一連串失地中最刺痛的一記，它暴露了荊襄防線的鬆散，也直接催生了孟珙的整軍與備砲：江陵、襄樊在1236至1239年間仍能成建制地抵抗蒙古軍，讓蒙古的南下腳步延誤了好幾年。對蒙古而言，這一役證明了配重投石車配合撞車、雲梯、攻城塔的攻城組合在面對築有壕溝與城樓的江南州城時仍然奏效，砲兵與工匠隊伍從此固定成為大軍的組成部分。必須承認的是，這場戰爭本身的記載遠比襄樊之戰稀疏，細節多有散佚；能夠確定的是大方向：沔州在1235年前後易手，蒙古第一次把配重投石車架在長江中游的城下。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Mongols took Mianzhou. The names, establishment and line of retreat of the defenders are blurred in the surviving documents; what is known is that after the breach they fell back on the Jiangling and Wuchang line, that Mianzhou was held by the Mongols, and that in the early Yuan period officials were appointed there and the prefecture was brought under the Huguang Branch Secretariat, turning a frontier town into a rear base feeding the Xiang-E front. For the Song, the defeat at Mianzhou was the most stinging of the series of losses that had begun with the Duanping era: it exposed the looseness of the Jingxiang defence and directly drove Meng Gong's reorganisation and preparation of artillery. Jiangling and Xiangfan were still able to resist the Mongols with formed armies between 1236 and 1239, delaying the southern advance by several years. For the Mongols, the battle showed that the combination of counterweight trebuchets with battering rams, ladders and siege towers still worked against southern cities furnished with ditches and gate towers, and artillery crews and engineers became a fixed component of the great armies. It must be admitted that the record of this war is far thinner than that of the Xiangfan siege and much detail is lost; what can be fixed with confidence is the general shape: Mianzhou changed hands around 1235, and for the first time the Mongols set counterweight trebuchets up beneath a city on the middle Yangtze.
